article_number: Formal Malaysia riba entry (IFSA ss.28/29/152/153/167/168; CBA ss.56–58; BNM SAC)
content:
record_grade=formal (promoted from structural sample on 2026-09-14).

Malaysia transforms the Shariah prohibition of riba into binding obligations for Islamic finance through a statutory–SAC chain:
(1) IFSA 2013 (Act 759) does not use the word 'riba'. Prohibition operates via the duty to ensure Shariah compliance (s.28), Bank standards on Shariah matters (s.29), market prohibition of conduct contrary to Shariah (s.153(1)(a)), and Bank directions including derecognition of non-Shariah income (s.167(a), s.168(2)(a)(v)). Under s.28(2), compliance with a BNM Shariah Advisory Council (SAC) ruling is deemed compliance with Shariah. Official English AGC reprint as at 11 Feb 2021; https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1691495_BI/11022021%20ACT%20759%20final.pdf
(2) CBA 2009 (Act 701) ss.56–58 (AGC reprint as at 1 Nov 2020) require courts/arbitrators to consider or refer Shariah questions to the SAC, make SAC rulings on such references binding on IFIs and the referring court/arbitrator, and give SAC rulings priority over internal Shariah committees. https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1683920_BI/Draf%20Kedua%20Act%20701%20(final)(KU)%20(1).pdf
(3) BNM SAC identifies interest/riba as prohibited by Shariah; core compiled Resolution 81 (2nd ed. 2010, PDF pp.149–150): 'the imposition of interests or riba is prohibited by Shariah'. Related direct Resolutions: 32, 33, 37, 46, 77, 78, 81, 83, 107, 123, 131. Official compilation URL: https://www.bnm.gov.my/documents/20124/9198675/shariah_resolutions_2nd_edition_EN.pdf (local copy is a content-verification copy; MD5 08e35a8c9aa2faafc5285d8d9d794484).
(4) Religious anchor (shared layer only; not alone a compliance basis): Quran al-Baqarah 2:275–279 and verified hadith numbers under SH-PRINCIPLE-RIBA-001.

Pending verification (explicitly not invented):
- Sahih Muslim Khutbat al-Wada' riba-abolition subdivision number on sunnah.com;
- Latin transliteration of Quran 2:275–279 not separately collected;
- BNM SAC 2nd ed. 2010 local file is a content-verification copy (direct bnm.gov.my download failed); confirm against official URL before production citation of long quotes.
rule_subject: 禁止 riba（利息、高利贷）— 马来西亚正式转化条目
national_transformation: 正式条目。IFSA 2013 ss.28/29/152/153/167/168（Shariah 合规与市场/指令链条）＋ CBA 2009 ss.56–58（SAC 提交、拘束力、优先）＋ BNM SAC Resolutions 32/33/37/46/77/78/81/83/107/123/131 及第210/213次会议（interest/riba 禁止与替代机制）。共享层经训见 SH-PRINCIPLE-RIBA-001，不得单独作为合规结论。
parallel_languages: 英文权威（IFSA/CBA/SAC）；阿语经训见共享层；马来文国家语文本另有；中文仅为导读

applicability_person: 持牌伊斯兰金融机构及其董事、CEO、高级职员、沙里亚委员会；指定支付系统运营商；伊斯兰货币/外汇市场参与者；审理伊斯兰金融业务争议的法院与仲裁员（依 CBA ss.56–57）
applicability_subject: 伊斯兰金融业务中的 riba/interest 禁止与 Shariah 合规（含融资、takaful、伊斯兰货币与外汇市场、迟付收费、qard、重组展期等，依各关联条款）
arabic_text:
2:275 ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ لَا يَقُومُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَقُومُ ٱلَّذِى يَتَخَبَّطُهُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ مِنَ ٱلْمَسِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْبَيْعُ مِثْلُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۗ وَأَحَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْبَيْعَ وَحَرَّمَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ ۚ فَمَن جَآءَهُۥ مَوْعِظَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ فَٱنتَهَىٰ فَلَهُۥ مَا سَلَفَ وَأَمْرُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَنْ عَادَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

2:276 يَمْحَقُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ وَيُرْبِى ٱلصَّدَقَـٰتِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ أَثِيمٍ

2:277 إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

2:278 يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَذَرُوا۟ مَا بَقِىَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

2:279 فَإِن لَّمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَأْذَنُوا۟ بِحَرْبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَإِن تُبْتُمْ فَلَكُمْ رُءُوسُ أَمْوَٰلِكُمْ لَا تَظْلِمُونَ وَلَا تُظْلَمُونَ
